title: Autos funcionales: VehicleFactory + spawner en el parking del HQ
request: Agregar autos conducibles al juego. Chasis y drivetrain con codigo propio (traccion total con HingeConstraint Motor + direccion Servo delantera), sin scripts de la Toolbox. Dos unidades en el parking del HQ (-80, ., -30) con reposicion automatica.

operations.source:
-- VehicleFactory v1 - autos arcade construidos con codigo propio, sin assets de terceros.
-- Chasis + 4 ruedas con HingeConstraint: traccion en las cuatro (Motor) y direccion
-- delantera (Servo). Ningun script de la Toolbox: es el vector clasico de backdoors.
-- Escala segun memory/WORLD.md: 1 stud ~ 0,28 m, avatar ~5 studs, calzada 14 studs.

local DEFAULTS = {
	bodySize = Vector3.new(6, 2, 14),
	bodyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40), -- naranja de marca
	wheelRadius = 1.5,
	wheelWidth = 1.2,
	axleZ = 4.5,
	rideHeight = 2.2,
	maxAngularVelocity = 33, -- rad/s -> ~50 studs/s con radio 1.5 (a pie: 16 / sprint 24)
	motorTorque = 45000,
	motorAcceleration = 80,
	brakeTorque = 90000,
	maxSteerAngle = 30,
	steerSpeed = 6,
	driveSign = -1, -- si W va marcha atras, cambiar a 1
	steerSign = -1, -- si D gira al reves, cambiar a 1
}

local VehicleFactory = {}
VehicleFactory.Defaults = DEFAULTS

local function newPart(props, parent)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		part[key] = value
	end
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function attach(parent, cf)
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.CFrame = cf
	a.Parent = parent
	return a
end

local function weld(a, b)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = a
	w.Part1 = b
	w.Parent = a
	return w
end

local function sinColision(a, b)
	local n = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
	n.Part0 = a
	n.Part1 = b
	n.Parent = a
end

-- Create { name?, color?, cframe?, parent? } -> Model
function VehicleFactory.Create(config)
	config = config or {}
	local cfg = setmetatable({}, { __index = DEFAULTS })
	for key, value in pairs(config) do
		cfg[key] = value
	end
	local origen = cfg.cframe or CFrame.new(0, cfg.rideHeight, 0)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = cfg.name or "DeliveryCar"

	local body = newPart({
		Name = "Body",
		Size = cfg.bodySize,
		CFrame = origen,
		Color = cfg.color or cfg.bodyColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	local cabina = newPart({
		Name = "Cabin",
		Size = Vector3.new(5.2, 1.8, 6),
		CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 1.9, 0.8),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52),
		Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.2, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	weld(body, cabina)

	local caja = newPart({
		Name = "CargoBed",
		Size = Vector3.new(5.6, 1.2, 4.5),
		CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, -4.4),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 74, 82),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	weld(body, caja)

	local diametro = cfg.wheelRadius * 2
	local offsetX = cfg.bodySize.X / 2 + cfg.wheelWidth / 2
	local offsetY = cfg.wheelRadius - cfg.rideHeight
	local motores, servos = {}, {}

	local function crearRueda(nombre, lx, lz, esDireccion)
		local wheel = newPart({
			Name = nombre,
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(cfg.wheelWidth, diametro, diametro),
			CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34),
			Material = Enum.Material.Rubber,
			CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(1.2, 2, 0.2, 4, 1),
		}, model)
		sinColision(wheel, body)
		sinColision(wheel, cabina)
		sinColision(wheel, caja)

		local anclaje = body
		if esDireccion then
			local hub = newPart({
				Name = nombre .. "_Hub",
				Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
				CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz),
				Transparency = 1,
				CanCollide = false,
				CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2),
			}, model)
			sinColision(hub, body)
			sinColision(hub, wheel)
			-- eje vertical: girar 90 grados en Z lleva el eje X del attachment a +Y
			local vertical = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			local servo = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
			servo.Name = nombre .. "_Steer"
			servo.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
			servo.ServoMaxTorque = 1000000
			servo.AngularSpeed = cfg.steerSpeed
			servo.LimitsEnabled = true
			servo.LowerAngle = -cfg.maxSteerAngle
			servo.UpperAngle = cfg.maxSteerAngle
			servo.TargetAngle = 0
			servo.Attachment0 = attach(body, CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz) * vertical)
			servo.Attachment1 = attach(hub, vertical)
			servo.Parent = body
			table.insert(servos, servo)
			anclaje = hub
		end

		local motor = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
		motor.Name = nombre .. "_Motor"
		motor.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
		motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.motorTorque
		motor.MotorMaxAcceleration = cfg.motorAcceleration
		motor.AngularVelocity = 0
		motor.Attachment0 = attach(anclaje, anclaje == body and CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz) or CFrame.new())
		motor.Attachment1 = attach(wheel, CFrame.new())
		motor.Parent = body
		table.insert(motores, motor)
	end

	crearRueda("Wheel_FL", -offsetX, -cfg.axleZ, true)
	crearRueda("Wheel_FR", offsetX, -cfg.axleZ, true)
	crearRueda("Wheel_RL", -offsetX, cfg.axleZ, false)
	crearRueda("Wheel_RR", offsetX, cfg.axleZ, false)

	local seat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
	seat.Name = "DriverSeat"
	seat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2)
	seat.CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 2)
	seat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52)
	seat.MaxSpeed = 0
	seat.Torque = 0
	seat.TurnSpeed = 0
	seat.HeadsUpDisplay = false
	seat.Parent = model
	weld(body, seat)

	local function frenar()
		for _, motor in ipairs(motores) do
			motor.AngularVelocity = 0
			motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.brakeTorque
		end
		for _, servo in ipairs(servos) do
			servo.TargetAngle = 0
		end
	end

	local function aplicar()
		local throttle = seat.Throttle
		if throttle == 0 then
			for _, motor in ipairs(motores) do
				motor.AngularVelocity = 0
				motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.brakeTorque
			end
		else
			for _, motor in ipairs(motores) do
				motor.AngularVelocity = cfg.driveSign * throttle * cfg.maxAngularVelocity
				motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.motorTorque
			end
		end
		local objetivo = cfg.steerSign * seat.Steer * cfg.maxSteerAngle
		for _, servo in ipairs(servos) do
			servo.TargetAngle = objetivo
		end
	end

	seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Throttle"):Connect(aplicar)
	seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Steer"):Connect(aplicar)
	seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
		if not seat.Occupant then
			frenar()
		end
	end)
	frenar()

	model.Parent = cfg.parent or workspace
	pcall(function()
		model:SetAttribute("_RBX_Vehicle", "DeliveryCar_v1")
	end)
	return model
end

return VehicleFactory

-- VehicleSpawner - coloca los autos del parking del HQ (memory/WORLD.md seccion 4) y los
-- repone si alguien los borra o se caen del mapa. El HQ ocupa x de -66 a -26; el parking
-- queda al oeste, en x = -84 y -76, con el morro mirando al sur (+z).

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Factory = require(script.Parent.VehicleFactory)

local ALTURA = Factory.Defaults.rideHeight
local SPAWNS = {
	{ name = "DeliveryCar_1", pos = Vector3.new(-84, ALTURA, -30), yaw = 180, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40) },
	{ name = "DeliveryCar_2", pos = Vector3.new(-76, ALTURA, -30), yaw = 180, color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 74, 82) },
}

local carpeta = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Vehicles")
if not carpeta then
	carpeta = Instance.new("Folder")
	carpeta.Name = "Vehicles"
	carpeta.Parent = Workspace
end

local function crear(spec)
	return Factory.Create({
		name = spec.name,
		color = spec.color,
		parent = carpeta,
		cframe = CFrame.new(spec.pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spec.yaw), 0),
	})
end

for _, spec in ipairs(SPAWNS) do
	if not carpeta:FindFirstChild(spec.name) then
		crear(spec)
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(5)
		for _, spec in ipairs(SPAWNS) do
			local auto = carpeta:FindFirstChild(spec.name)
			if not auto then
				crear(spec)
			else
				local base = auto.PrimaryPart
				if base and base.Position.Y < -20 then
					auto:Destroy()
					crear(spec)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

print(("[Vehicles] %d autos listos en el parking del HQ"):format(#SPAWNS))
